name: text-bar-wipe
title: Bar Wipe Reveal
description: Một thanh màu nhấn mọc ra phủ dòng chữ rồi rút về phía phải, chữ hiện ra ngay sau mép thanh, mỗi dòng cách nhau 0.08 giây.

moworks.author: moworks

options.duration: s the bar grows, then the same to pull away (0.4 + 0.4)
options.exit: s after the start for the mirrored exit (null: stay)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Per line (80 ms apart): accent bar (line height × 1.06, 8 px past each side) scaleX 0 → 1 from the left in 0.4 s power2.inOut, then 1 → 0 toward the right in 0.4 s; the text is clipped to the area left of the bar trailing edge, so it appears as the bar pulls away. Exit mirrors (bar grows over the text, text clipped right of the leading edge). Demo: in from 0.3 s, exit from 2.7 s; loop 4 s. Params: duration: mọc / rút (0.4 s + 0.4 s) · stagger: giữa các dòng (0.08 s) · color: màu thanh (màu nhấn) · overhang (8 px).
moworks.titleVi: Thanh màu quét qua để lộ chữ
